applicability.scope: Source-grounded ComfyUI workflow-output cache and model-weight ownership audit; confirm the actual revision, node registry, cache caller and static/dynamic patcher before transfer.
applicability.prerequisites: Access to the pinned provenance and the actual node registry/cache caller; residency questions additionally require the concrete patcher and effective dynamic/static mode. Native memory conclusions need the actual backend.
applicability.input_contract: Exact revision, API-format prompt/output targets, relevant node classes/constants/links/hidden inputs and external state, selected cache caller/mode and patcher settings, plus available execution/load/memory/timing observations.
applicability.produced_artifact: A state/owner/key/lifetime/consumer ledger with invalidation or release events, evidence and unresolved boundaries, followed by a discriminating check and its actual result.
applicability.failure_modes: Treating identical JSON as proof of unchanged external inputs, confusing eviction with key validity, or equating workflow cache hits with device-resident model weights can explain the wrong state contract.
applicability.refusal_point: Stop when the cause/action is supported or required environment, backend or model resources are unavailable; do not manufacture a hit, hardware result or performance threshold.

limitations: Source-derived candidate; no local executor-cache, device-residency or performance qualification.
Seven self-authored cases exercised only the unchanged pure upstream graph_utils module; they do not verify PromptExecutor, cache signatures or model behavior.
The dynamic native allocator and third-party custom-node behavior remain outside the verified scope.
recommendations: Draw the affected dependency cone with declared, lazy and dynamically expanded links, then mark unfingerprinted external state unresolved.
Separate output/object cache validity and retention from patch identity, partial unload, full detach and allocator-visible release.
Change one test variable while fixing prompt, output target, model, backend, precision, seed and cache mode; check values and executed nodes before timing.
